certificate.law: A complete guarded single-head row has its successor head at distance at most one. At an ordinary input center, the output is its old symbol or a head carrying that same symbol. Thus cells outside the write cone retain their underlying input values. All pins concern projections of actual original symbol values; no proof path is supplied.
